column4: Pixel-art texture in the style of 1990s Build-engine games (Duke Nukem 3D, Blood, Redneck Rampage): a digitized photograph crudely retouched by hand by a 1996 game artist, flat even lighting, no glow, no bloom, no steam, no smoke, no depth of field, no soft shadows, chunky pixels, a limited muddy palette, low saturation, slightly grimy and imperfect, hard edges, no readable text, no logos, no border, no watermark, no people, no hands. A flat orthographic straight-on front view, no perspective, filling the whole 16:9 canvas edge to edge: The barman's side of a 1980s Czech village pub bar. In the middle a tall chrome beer tower with one long black tap handle standing up and a short curved spout, under it a ribbed steel drip tray with nothing on it. On the left a long empty steel draining board. On the right an empty stretch of worn dark wooden bar top, a folded white bar towel at the far right edge. Behind, dark brown wood panelling. Absolutely no glasses, no mugs and no bottles anywhere.
